versions.name: Hale Scout Reservation

features.note: Lake Bohannon, used for open boating and fishing.
There is a fishing dock on the lake.
An inflatable iceberg climbing structure on the lake.
Horsemanship merit badge plus trail rides.
A technology center; merit badges include game design and artificial intelligence.
A renovated waterfront pavilion and four scoutcraft pavilions.
Canvas wall tents on wooden platforms, two cots per tent.
An electrical outlet in each campsite.
Running water and hot showers near every campsite.

versions.summary: Indian Nations Council's 620-acre Scouts BSA resident camp set in the Winding Stair Mountains within the Ouachita National Forest.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
